title: 4‑BR 30A Vacation Rental Home with Beach Access & Communal Pool
meta_description: Experience Crow's Nest, a 4-BR, 3.5-bath 30A vacation cottage with a communal pool, outdoor grill, and beach access. Accommodates 10 guests.
description_expanded: Welcome to Crow's Nest, a charming beach cottage located in Cassine Village, a family-friendly neighborhood located off 30A, just 352 yards from the beach! Crow's Nest is a comfortable 2-story home with over 2,000 sq. ft of living space ready for guests to enjoy. The famous 30A beaches are less than a 5-minute walk away.Crow's Nest features an open floor plan for easy entertaining, dining, and meal prep. The living area is set up for comfort with plenty of seating around the 75" TV exclusively equipped with YouTube TV for your entertainment. The kitchen provides any chef all the modern conveniences with ample cabinet space and a walk-in pantry.The dining table seats up to 6, and the kitchen bar seats 4. The laundry room is located adjacent to the kitchen and features an oversized washer/dryer. There's a full bath conveniently located off the foyer.This home includes 4 bedrooms and 4 full bathrooms, providing privacy and comfort for all guests. Upstairs and downstairs bedrooms each have bathrooms for added convenience.Outside you'll find an enclosed shower (with hot water!) to use after a fun day in the sun. The front porch and backyard patio with a gas grill provide additional living spaces for your family's vacation enjoyment!Sleeping Arrangements:1st Floor, Bedroom 1 (Master): King bed, 65" TV, bathroom with dual vanities, soaking tub, and large shower.1st Floor, Bedroom 2: Queen bed, TV, desk area. Patio access. Bathroom with full bath.2nd Floor, Bedroom 3: Queen bed, TV, private balcony. Bathroom with dual sinks and large shower.2nd Floor, Bedroom 4: 2 full beds, desk area, TV. Bathroom with tub/shower combo.Beach Access:Head west on Sweet Bay Drive then south on Robert Ellis Street. Cross 30A and you'll end at your beach access, One Seagrove PlaceDistance: 0.2 miles | Time: 5 minutes walkingCassine Village:Cassine Village within Cassine Gardens is a charming neighborhood in a natural setting. This property located in the heart of beautiful Seagrove Beach features on-site tennis courts, your choice of 2 pools, a nature trail through a native cypress forest, and a pond. Take a 5-minute walk along the bricked sidewalks to the pristine sands of the Emerald Coast. The kids can explore the nature trail or fish from the bridge over the community pond. And, they can enjoy their bikes along the quiet streets or the family can pedal to Seaside. There are 26 miles of trails along 30A. You’re only a short walk for a pizza at Brozinni’s Pizzeria or your favorite pasta dish at Angelina’s. Make reservations at Café Thirty-A for an upscale dining experience, or bike to Goatfeather’s Seafood for the catch of the day.Your stay at Crow's Nest comes with Xplorie’s best activities! One ticket per day, per activity! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Sorry, no pets allowed.* Parking for 4 car.* Monthly Rentals Available - Call for RatesAn initial Benchmark signature box of amenities is provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, 1 pack of kitchen wipes and liners for each trashcan plus 2 washing machine pods. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of facial and bath soaps/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom.
